properties.statement:
AN AGENT WITH A CORRECT SUBSTANTIVE ANSWER TO A GAP HAS NO HONEST WAY TO RECORD IT. Measured in musicjug, 2026-08-31 (art:musicjug-genesis-feedback-2026-08-31, "The bad" §6), and CORRECTED the same day by a measurement — see the correction below.

`decomposition_coverage` asked a real question — "what did the parent hold that none of its children hold?" — and the session had a real answer: four children say WHAT she learns, and a newly-added fifth carries the HOW, which was the part actually at risk of being designed away.

Two exits were offered and neither fits: write another child (wrong — nothing was left over), or `acknowledge_gap`, which is the OWNER's word by definition and refuses an unknown approver. The session acknowledged with the owner named, honest only because they had endorsed the reading one message earlier. "Without that I would have had to leave a solved gap open as noise."

🛑 CORRECTION, 2026-08-31, from reading the tool surface rather than the report: **`answer_question` DOES accept a `gap_id`** (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/ask.rs:294), so the affordance is not absent as first recorded here. What is absent is an HONEST USE of it by an agent: its own description reads "Record what the user said in reply to a question", so an agent putting its own reasoning there would be recording its answer as the user's. That is the same forgery `acknowledge_gap`'s approver rule exists to prevent.

⭐ SO THE FINDING SURVIVES AND ITS SHAPE CHANGES. The problem is not a missing verb; it is that reflow2's vocabulary for recording THE USER'S word is well developed and its vocabulary for recording THE AGENT'S is almost empty — see `fact:reflow2-has-a-vocabulary-for-the-users-word-and-none-for-the-agents`. The one place the other half IS modelled is a Decision at `proposed` carrying an approver, which musicjug praised in the same report without connecting it to this complaint.

📌 THE GAP TEXT ITSELF NAMES BOTH MOVES: "Write the answer into the design ... or acknowledge_gap." Only the second reads as available to an agent.

⚠️ WHY THIS IS NOT AN ARGUMENT TO RELAX THE APPROVER RULE. Acknowledging is a JUDGEMENT that the design is fine as it stands, and an agent forging that is exactly what `fact:acknowledge-gap-records-a-judgement-without-recording-whose` was fixed to stop. Answering is a different act: it makes a claim that is itself checkable and re-expires. Collapsing the two in either direction loses something.
